intro: While investigating the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore, the ancient of lore Onu enters a deep trance to contemplate the growing threat. Players who lose their mystical scrying phial can speak to the meditating ancient to receive a replacement. His thoughts center on the sinister alliance and motivations of the Twilight's Hammer cult and the serpentine naga.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am meditating on your task, friend. Meditating on reasons why the Twilight's Hammer and naga are here.
When you are ready, use the phial of scrying to create a scrying bowl. Then, contact me through the bowl.
If you have lost your phial of scrying, then here is another.
